name: MBW - Social Media Analytics v5 - Production

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'gpt-oss:20b', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You interpret already-calculated organic social media evidence for Mindo Bird Watching. Never invent or recalculate numbers. The value and baseline fields are performance measures, never post counts; sample_size is the only count. Use only the supplied patterns. Treat associations as hypotheses, not causes. Return one cautious interpretation and one practical single-variable experiment per evidence ID. Return valid JSON only.' }, { role: 'user', content: `Evidence: ${JSON.stringify($json.observed_patterns || [])}\nFilters cover ${$json.period || 'the selected period'}. Every pattern is already limited to the platform field supplied with it. For Instagram, views_or_reach means reach; for Facebook it means unique viewers or media views; for YouTube it means views. The statistic field says whether value is a median or average. sample_size is the number of matched platform results supporting the pattern. For every supplied evidence item, return: {"items":[{"evidence_id":"exact supplied id","interpretation":"plain-language explanation that correctly names the platform, metric, statistic, and sample size","experiment":"one specific next test that changes only one variable and compares the same metric within the same platform"}]}. For a format pattern, compare the named format against another actual format while holding subject, day, and time as similar as possible; a carousel is a multi-image post and must never be called a single image. For a timing pattern, keep platform, format, and subject similar and compare the named slot with one other slot. Do not describe value as a number of posts. Do not mention any platform not named in that evidence item. Do not call an early or developing signal proven. Do not recommend a posting time unless it appears in the supplied evidence.` }], stream: false, think: 'low', format: 'json', keep_alive: '30m', options: { temperature: 0.1, num_predict: 900 } } }}
